{{Quote|You hunters are the best that the galaxy's goons and thug lords could send us. Now show us which one of you will join the Great Hunt.|Huntmaster Assistant [[Lek]]|<ref name="Melee" />}}
'''Partogg''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who competed to participated in the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Partogg was one of a dozen hunters who competed for the last spot in the Great Hunt,<ref name="Huntmaster" /> and he succeeded in acquiring the three [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] he was assigned in order to advance. He competed in the [[Grand Melee]] against several other hunters, but was slain in the fighting. He wore a set of [[Color/Legends|black]] and gray [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="Melee" />
